title: Octopus Masters Hidden Colors

scenes.text: Octopus can shift its skin tone in under a second.
scenes.query: octopus skin color change time lapse

scenes.label: CHROMATOPHORES CONTROL COLORS
scenes.text: Special cells called chromatophores expand or contract to produce vivid patterns.

scenes.label: IRIDOPHORES REFLECT LIGHT
scenes.text: Iridophores reflect light, giving the animal shimmering blues and greens.

scenes.label: LEUCOPHORES CREATE WHITE
scenes.text: Leucophores scatter ambient light, allowing the octopus to appear pure white when needed.
